versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection_basic:
    Image|endswith: \attrib.exe
    CommandLine|contains: ' +s'
selection_paths:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' %' # Custom Environment variable
        - '\Users\Public'
        - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
        - '\ProgramData\'
        - '\Downloads\'
selection_ext:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '.bat'
        - '.ps1'
        - '.vbe'
        - '.vbs'
        - '.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\attrib.exe" CommandLine="* +s*" CommandLine IN ("* %*", "*\\Users\\Public*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\ProgramData\\*", "*\\Downloads\\*") CommandLine IN ("*.bat*", "*.ps1*", "*.vbe*", "*.vbs*", "*.exe*")
